sloka: एवं विश्वासिता सीता हेतुभिः शोककर्शिता ।उपपन्नैरभिज्ञानैर्दूतं तमवगच्छति ।। ५.३५.८४।।।।
transliteration: evaṁ viśvāsitā sītā hetubhiḥ śokakarśitā ।upapannairabhijñānairdūtaṁ tamavagacchati ।। 5.35.84।।।।

translations.english: The griefstricken Sita trusted him by his logical presentation of reasons as well as identifications. She believed that he was a messenger (of Rama).
